### Borea v0.6.0-preview.game-builds.1: preview for developers only

**This build is ONLY for the Borea team and developers who test the "Game builds" feature. Do not use it if you only want to play.**
It is less tested than a dev build, it can change how Borea stores your instances, and going back to a normal Borea needs the steps at the end of these notes.
For normal use, stay on v0.5.2. No update channel offers this build, and it does not update itself, so you only get it if you download it here by hand.
Tell us what did not work: [Discord](https://discord.gg/nt4fK4QuTz) | [GitHub issues](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea/issues)

#### What is new

- An instance can keep the KSA build it was made for. On the instance page, "Keep this game build" copies the current build once into the Game Builds folder of the library, and the instance then always starts on that build, also after the Ahwoo client updates KSA.
- Settings, Game has "Keep a build from a folder", for an old install or an unpacked archive that you already have.
- Compatibility of mods, packs and mod lists is checked against the build of each instance, in the App and the CLI.
- When an instance moves back to the current build, Borea shows how its mods fit first, and it can remove a kept build that no instance uses.
- Each instance can have its own mod loader version, Automatic or a fixed version. For an instance on a kept build, Automatic offers the newest StarMap release that fits that build, also an older one, and installs it beside the newer one.

#### Please test these first

- Keep the current build for an instance, wait for the next KSA update, and play that instance. KSA should start on the kept build, with your mods.
- Keep a build that only an older StarMap fits, for example with only the newest StarMap installed. Play should offer the older StarMap and start the kept build with it.
- While a game on a kept build runs, play another instance that uses the same StarMap folder. Borea should refuse with "A game is running".

#### Before you go back to v0.5.2

- v0.5.2 does not know kept builds. When it saves an instance, it drops the kept build of that instance, and the instance then starts on the current build.
- Borea writes the game folder of the instance into `StarMapConfig.json` before each start, and writes your normal game folder back when a game on a kept build ends. If you closed Borea or used `borea launch` while such a game ran, set `GameLocation` in `StarMapConfig.json` back to your game folder by hand, or start the instance once more from this preview.
- A kept build is a full copy of KSA, about 2.8 GB on Windows.
